title: Scrubb's Buzzer-Beater Puts Soles Two Wins From the Title as the LNBP Final Heads to Guadalajara
excerpt: Philip Scrubb buried a three-pointer with two seconds left to give the Soles de Mexicali a 73-70 win over the Astros de Jalisco in Game 2 of the LNBP Grand Final, putting Mexicali up 2-0 as the best-of-seven series moves to Guadalajara.
content:
Philip Scrubb hit a three-pointer with two seconds left on Friday night, and the Soles de Mexicali stole a 73-70 win over the Astros de Jalisco in Game 2 of the LNBP Grand Final. The Soles lead the best-of-seven series 2-0 and are two wins away from their fifth league championship.

The shot capped a comeback. Jalisco led for most of the night at the Auditorio PSF in Mexicali and was still ahead by 15 points late in the fourth quarter before Mexicali stormed back. Scrubb finished with 20 points, 15 of them from three-point range, plus six rebounds and three assists.

Mexicali had taken Game 1 on Thursday, 85-66, in front of its home crowd. Now the series shifts to Guadalajara, where Games 3 and 4 will be played Monday, Nov. 16, and Tuesday, Nov. 17, at Arena Astros, both at 8:15 p.m. central Mexico time. The series follows a 2-3-2 format, with Games 5, 6 and 7, if needed, back in Mexicali. A deciding Game 7 would be played Monday, Nov. 23.

The Soles reached the final by beating the Panteras de Aguascalientes 110-79 on Nov. 5, closing out the Zona Caliente final 4-1. Erik Thomas led Mexicali with 24 points in the clincher. It is the ninth league final in club history for the Soles, coached by Pablo García.

The Astros, coached by Iván Déniz, swept the defending champion Fuerza Regia 4-0 in their zone final, closing the series with an 82-77 win on Nov. 3. It is Jalisco's first trip to the Grand Final since 2023.

Sources: Expreso Deportivo, Nov. 13, 2026; P24, Nov. 14, 2026; En Juego Deportes, Nov. 12-13, 2026; AgsSports, Nov. 5, 2026; Vértigo Deportivo, Nov. 4, 2026.
